## Purpose and Scope

Provides illustrative patterns for end-to-end identity proofing — IAL determination logic, proofing channel selection, external CSP (ID.me) integration topology, and enrollment workflow.

**Paired ABBs**:
- [GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-2.2.05](../GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-2.2.05.md) — Identity Proofing ABB
- [GUID-SEC-IAM-ID.ME-STRATEGY-2.2.10](../GUID-SEC-IAM-ID.ME-STRATEGY-2.2.10.md) — ID.me Integration Strategy ABB

**Related ABBs**: [GUID-SEC-IAM-IDENTITY-BROKER-2.2.02](../GUID-SEC-IAM-IDENTITY-BROKER-2.2.02.md) — broker-mediated CSP assertion acceptance

[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#capability-domain-boundary]

### Capability Domain Boundary

Identity proofing scope begins at the enrollment event — the point at which a new identity is being established — and ends at the IAL record being written to the enterprise identity store. Subsequent authentication against the proofed identity is governed by the ZTA Authentication RAD. Downstream access entitlement based on IAL is governed by Authorization (GUID-SEC-IAM-AUTHZ-2.2.08, draft).

[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#architecture-diagram]

### Architecture Diagram

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User
    participant App as Enrollment Application
    participant IdP as "Enterprise IdP / Broker"
    participant CSP as "External CSP (ID.me)"
    participant Store as Identity Store

    User->>App: Initiate enrollment
    App-->>IdP: Redirect - enrollment request (IAL context included)
    Note over IdP: Evaluate IAL requirement and select proofing channel
    IdP-->>User: Redirect to External CSP for IAL2 proofing
    User->>CSP: Begin proofing session
    Note over CSP: Document verification, biometric matching, liveness detection, fraud screening
    CSP-->>User: Redirect to IdP ACS with signed IAL2 assertion
    User->>IdP: Deliver CSP assertion via ACS callback
    Note over IdP: Validate assertion signature, audience, and recency then correlate fraud signals
    IdP->>Store: Write IAL2 record to identity profile
    Store-->>IdP: Confirm
    IdP-->>App: Enrollment complete - IAL2
    App-->>User: Access granted at IAL2
```

| Enterprise IdP / Broker | GUID-SEC-IAM-IDENTITY-BROKER-2.2.02, GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-2.2.05 | Federation mediation; IAL determination and proofing channel orchestration; CSP assertion validation; IAL record write to identity store |

| Identity Store | GUID-SEC-IAM-REF-2.2.01 (composite) | Persistent IAL record for the enrolling identity; written by the IdP/Broker after assertion validation |

[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#pattern-1-remote-ial2-proofing-via-external-csp]

### Pattern 1: Remote IAL2 Proofing via External CSP

**When to use**: Medicaid member enrollment, provider enrollment, or any population requiring IAL2 where in-person proofing is not operationally practical

**Logical flow**:
1. Enrollment application initiates proofing workflow; IdP determines IAL2 is required and selects the external CSP proofing channel
2. IdP redirects the user's browser to the external CSP (ID.me) for IAL2 proofing
3. User completes CSP-directed proofing: document capture, biometric selfie, liveness detection, fraud screening
4. CSP redirects the user's browser back to the IdP ACS with a signed IAL2 assertion
5. Broker validates the assertion (signature, audience, recency) and writes the IAL2 result to the identity store
6. IAL2 is available as an identity attribute for downstream authorization decisions

page_texts.12:
[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#pattern-2-step-up-proofing-for-existing-identity]

### Pattern 2: Step-Up Proofing for Existing Identity

**When to use**: User enrolled at IAL1 requests access to a resource that requires IAL2

**Logical flow**:
1. IdP detects IAL2 requirement at access time; user's current IAL record is IAL1
2. IdP redirects user to proofing service for step-up proofing
3. Proofing service invokes external CSP; user completes IAL2 proofing
4. IAL record in identity store is updated from IAL1 to IAL2
5. IdP re-evaluates the access request with the updated IAL; grants access if all conditions are met

page_texts.13:
[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#pattern-3-accessible-proofing-channel-fallback]

### Pattern 3: Accessible Proofing Channel Fallback

**When to use**: User cannot complete automated remote proofing (device limitation, accessibility need, document type not supported)

**Logical flow**:
1. Automated proofing channel fails or is declined by user
2. Proofing service presents alternative channel options: video-assisted proofing, in-person proofing location, trusted referee pathway
3. User selects an accessible alternative and completes the proofing through that channel
4. Proofing outcome is recorded with the channel used; IAL record is updated accordingly

[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#deployment-context-considerations]

## Deployment Context Considerations

| Context | Architectural Consideration |
|---|---|
| Medicaid member enrollment | IAL2 via ID.me is the standard pattern for remote member enrollment; in-person proofing at DHS offices is the fallback for populations who cannot complete digital proofing |
| Provider enrollment | Provider identity may use alternative evidence types (NPI, state license); proofing service must support evidence types beyond consumer identity documents |
| Trusted referee | Trusted referee pathway availability must be operationally supported; this RAD defines the architectural pattern but the process for identifying and authorizing trusted referees is a program governance concern |

[strategy/guidance/security/Identity/ref-arch/GUID-SEC-IAM-PROOFING-RAD-2.3.04.md#constraints-and-exceptions]

## Constraints and Exceptions

- IAL2 assertion validity from external CSP is time-limited; expired assertions must not be accepted without re-proofing
- Privacy impact assessments for external CSP integration must be current before production use; lapsed assessments require integration suspension
- IAL records SHALL be treated as PII and subject to the enterprise data classification and retention policy
